mapper.select: /* 권한 그룹 목록 조회 roleManage.selectRoleList */ SELECT ROLE_ID , ROLE_NAME , DESCRIPTION , USE_YN , DEFAULT_YN , CREATE_DT , MODIFY_DT FROM TB_ROLE_GRP ORDER BY CREATE_DT ASC, ROLE_ID ASC
/* 권한 그룹 단건 조회 roleManage.selectRole */ SELECT ROLE_ID , ROLE_NAME , DESCRIPTION , USE_YN , DEFAULT_YN , CREATE_DT , MODIFY_DT FROM TB_ROLE_GRP WHERE ROLE_ID = #{roleId}

/* 이동 대상 기본 권한 그룹 ID 조회 (기본 적용 그룹 우선, 없으면 사용 중인 그룹) roleManage.selectFallbackRoleId */ SELECT ROLE_ID FROM TB_ROLE_GRP WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND ROLE_ID != #{roleId} ORDER BY DEFAULT_YN DESC, CREATE_DT ASC, ROLE_ID ASC LIMIT 1

/* 그룹별 메뉴 권한 목록 조회 (전체 메뉴 + 부여 현황, 행 없으면 N) roleManage.selectRoleMenuList */ SELECT M.MENU_ID , M.MENU_NAME , M.PARN_MENU_ID , M.MENU_LEVEL , M.SORT_ORD , M.IS_LEAF , IFNULL(RM.READ_YN, 'N') AS READ_YN , IFNULL(RM.FUNC_YN, 'N') AS FUNC_YN FROM TB_MENU M LEFT JOIN TB_ROLE_MENU RM ON RM.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID AND RM.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.MENU_LEVEL ASC, M.SORT_ORD ASC, M.MENU_ID ASC

/* 권한 그룹 사용자 목록 조회 roleManage.selectRoleUserList */ SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USER_NM , U.EMAIL , U.ORG_ID , O.ORG_NM , UR.ROLE_ID FROM TB_USER_ROLE UR INNER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = UR.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = U.ORG_ID WHERE UR.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY U.USER_NM ASC, U.USER_ID ASC

/* 조직(하위 조직 포함) 사용자 목록 조회 roleManage.selectOrgUserList */
WITH RECURSIVE ORG_TREE AS ( SELECT ORG_ID FROM TB_ORG WHERE ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT C.ORG_ID FROM TB_ORG C INNER JOIN ORG_TREE P ON C.PARENT_ORG_ID = P.ORG_ID WHERE C.USE_YN = 'Y' )
SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USER_NM , U.EMAIL , U.ORG_ID , O.ORG_NM FROM TB_USER U
INNER JOIN ORG_TREE T ON T.ORG_ID = U.ORG_ID
LEFT JOIN TB_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = U.ORG_ID WHERE U.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{nameKeyword}), LOWER(U.USER_NM)) > 0
ORDER BY U.USER_NM ASC, U.USER_ID ASC

/* 사용자별 권한 지정 목록 조회 roleManage.selectUserRoleList */ SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USER_NM , U.EMAIL , U.ORG_ID , O.ORG_NM , UR.ROLE_ID , R.ROLE_NAME FROM TB_USER U LEFT JOIN TB_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = U.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_ROLE_GRP R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE U.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY U.USER_NM ASC, U.USER_ID ASC, R.ROLE_NAME ASC
mapper.insert: /* 신규 사용자에게 기본 적용 권한 그룹 지정 roleManage.insertDefaultUserRole */ INSERT INTO TB_USER_ROLE ( USER_ID , ROLE_ID , CREATE_DT , CREATE_ID ) SELECT #{userId} , R.ROLE_ID , NOW() , #{createId} FROM TB_ROLE_GRP R WHERE R.DEFAULT_YN = 'Y' AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY R.CREATE_DT ASC, R.ROLE_ID ASC LIMIT 1
